name: recall_memory
description: PRIORITY: Use this BEFORE investigating bugs or making changes. Search long-term project memory for relevant past context — decisions, discoveries, debugging outcomes, conventions, and prior conversations. Prevents repeating past mistakes and provides instant project context without reading files.

query.description: Natural language query describing what you want to recall (e.g. "what did we decide about the auth system?" or "how did we fix the rendering bug?")
